suggestions.msg: Well-structured CI workflow with correct concurrency serialization, proper secret handling, and comprehensive test gating.
Uses `CLAUDE_MODEL` env var which may not be documented/standard; `CLAUDE_MODEL_KEY` is the established env var name in Claude Code.
suggestions.suggestion: Use os.environ.get("CLAUDE_MODEL_KEY", "claude-sonnet-4-6") to match the documented env var name.

suggestions.msg: write_outputs uses plain string interpolation for GITHUB_OUTPUT; empty-string values become `issue_number=` which GitHub silently discards, making outputs unreliable across different runner locales.
suggestions.suggestion: Use the `gh output` command: subprocess.run(["gh", "attestation", ...]...) — or pipe through a heredoc with proper quoting; alternatively use `os.environ.get('GITHUB_OUTPUT', '')` with `shlexquote` to escape values.

suggestions.msg: ensure_label() runs unconditionally even when no issue is claimed, causing an unnecessary gh API call per workflow run.
suggestions.suggestion: Move ensure_label() inside select_issue() after confirming there is work to do, or guard it behind a targeted-issue-only path.

suggestions.msg: Uses `CLAUDE_MODEL` env var instead of the documented `CLAUDE_MODEL_KEY`.
comment_and_label applies the label before commenting; if commenting fails the label is already applied and next run will skip the issue without a clarifying comment.
suggestions.suggestion: Apply label and comment in a single gh call via --body (which also sets the label when using --add-label), or reorder so commenting succeeds before label is persisted.

suggestions.msg: api() swallows HTTPError body for non-200 responses by returning raw bytes without distinguishing a GitHub API error body from success — callers decode blindly which may produce garbage on e.g. 422 or 403.
suggestions.suggestion: On HTTPError, decode and include the 'message' or 'documentation_url' field from the error JSON in the die() output, e.g. err_data = json.loads(e.read()); die(f'...: {err_data.get("message")}')

suggestions.msg: GitHub REST API /issues endpoint is deprecated; the caller-filtered result still mixes issues and PRs before filtering client-side.
suggestions.suggestion: Use /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?labels={LABEL_READY}&state=open with --jq or server-side filtering already excludes PRs in many cases; alternatively migrate to GraphQL for precise filtering.

suggestions.msg: Magic number 100 limits search results with no explanation or config
suggestions.suggestion: Extract to a class constant (e.g. SEARCH_LIMIT = 100) or accept as a parameter with a default

suggestions.msg: create_customer does flush()+refresh() but other methods do the same — DRY opportunity
suggestions.suggestion: Consider a private _persist(self, customer) helper to reduce repeated flush()+refresh() pairs across 8+ methods
